finding.sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: perform a control SAML login with <OneTimeUse/>, then replay the exact same assertion (same Assertion/@ID) in a second login. Second attempt must be rejected if OneTimeUse and replay cache are enforced.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (replay should be rejected).

sequence.description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: perform a control SAML login with <OneTimeUse/>, then replay the exact same assertion (same Assertion/@ID) in a second login. Second attempt must be rejected if OneTimeUse and replay cache are enforced.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: A SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (and/or with the same Assertion ID) must not be accepted more than once; replaying the same assertion should be rejected.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login with OneTimeUse did not succeed; cannot evaluate replay enforcement.
Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (replay should be rejected).

finding.sequence_description: Replay a previously accepted SAML assertion after revoking the session from the first login. Revocation should not disable SAML replay protection; the same assertion must still be rejected on reuse.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_after_revoke_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_after_revoke_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion after session revocation; replay protection may be incorrectly tied to session state.

sequence.description: Replay a previously accepted SAML assertion after revoking the session from the first login. Revocation should not disable SAML replay protection; the same assertion must still be rejected on reuse.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: SAML assertion replay protection must be independent of downstream session revocation; revoking a session must not allow reusing the same SAML assertion again.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login did not succeed; cannot evaluate replay-after-revocation behavior.

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: Dex must reject a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) even when <OneTimeUse/> is not present; otherwise assertion replay is possible within validity window.

finding.description:

Evaluation: user_control_login_status=200 == True → False
Implication: Control SAML login failed; cannot attribute subsequent acceptance/rejection to Conditions enforcement.

finding.sequence_description: I5: Configure SAML connector to gate authentication on membership in an allowed group and filter emitted groups. Then attempt to authenticate as a user with no allowed group but with other groups, to see if Dex mistakenly grants a session/policies anyway (authz binding failure). Includes re-auth after config change.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_disallowedgroup_login_status == false
Evaluation: user_attacker_disallowedgroup_login_status=200 == False → False
Implication: Dex granted a session to a user lacking any allowedGroups membership, violating authorization binding (permissions granted without upstream group intent).

sequence.description: I5: Configure SAML connector to gate authentication on membership in an allowed group and filter emitted groups. Then attempt to authenticate as a user with no allowed group but with other groups, to see if Dex mistakenly grants a session/policies anyway (authz binding failure). Includes re-auth after config change.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: When allowedGroups is configured, Dex must not grant an authenticated session (and thus any effective permissions) unless the upstream assertion includes at least one allowed group; filterGroups must not weaken gating.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control login with allowed group failed; cannot evaluate allowedGroups gating.
Dex granted a session to a user lacking any allowedGroups membership, violating authorization binding (permissions granted without upstream group intent).

finding.sequence_description: I5 attack: attempt to bypass group-based authorization binding by confusing Dex's SAML groups parsing. Configure connector to require allowedGroups=['admins'] and set a nonstandard groups_delim. Then authenticate an attacker whose assertion carries a single groups attribute value that could be mis-parsed into including 'admins' (e.g., 'devs;admins') even though upstream intent is not true membership. Secure behavior: login rejected (or at least no 'admins' group emitted).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_composite_group_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_composite_group_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML login where the only asserted group value was a composite string ('devs;admins'); this suggests group parsing confusion bypassed allowedGroups gating, granting authorization beyond upstream intent.

sequence.description: I5 attack: attempt to bypass group-based authorization binding by confusing Dex's SAML groups parsing. sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: If Dex mis-parses the SAML groups attribute using an incorrect delimiter, it may treat a single composite group string as containing an allowed group and grant a session/policies beyond upstream intent.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control admin SAML login failed; cannot evaluate group parsing/authorization binding.

Dex accepted a SAML login where the only asserted group value was a composite string ('devs;admins'); this suggests group parsing confusion bypassed allowedGroups gating, granting authorization beyond upstream intent.
